lines.serbian: Pet je sati ujutru.
lines.english: It's five in the morning.

lines.serbian: Porodica Ilić stoji ispred zgrade sa četiri kofera.
lines.croatian: Obitelj Ilić stoji ispred zgrade s četiri kofera.
lines.english: The Ilić family is standing outside their building with four suitcases.

lines.serbian: Taksi dolazi. Vozač izlazi i gleda kofere.
lines.croatian: Taksi dolazi. Vozač izlazi i gleda kofere.
lines.english: The taxi arrives. The driver gets out and looks at the suitcases.

lines.serbian: – Ovo je mnogo kofera! – kaže.
lines.english: "That's a lot of suitcases!" he says.

lines.serbian: – Idemo na more na dve nedelje – kaže mama.
lines.croatian: – Idemo na more na dva tjedna – kaže mama.
lines.english: "We're going to the seaside for two weeks," says Mum.

lines.serbian: Vozač stavlja tri kofera u gepek.
lines.croatian: Vozač stavlja tri kofera u prtljažnik.
lines.english: The driver puts three suitcases in the boot.

lines.serbian: Četvrti kofer ide na zadnje sedište, pored dece.
lines.croatian: Četvrti kofer ide na stražnje sjedalo, pored djece.
lines.english: The fourth suitcase goes on the back seat, next to the children.

lines.serbian: – Na aerodrom, molim vas – kaže tata.
lines.croatian: – Do zračne luke, molim vas – kaže tata.
lines.english: "To the airport, please," says Dad.

lines.serbian: Ulice su prazne. Deca spavaju.
lines.english: The streets are empty. The children are asleep.

lines.serbian: – Imaš li pasoše? – pita mama.
lines.english: "Do you have the passports?" asks Mum.

lines.serbian: Tata gleda u torbu. Gleda u džepove.
lines.croatian: Tata gleda u torbu. Gleda u džepove.
lines.english: Dad looks in his bag. He looks in his pockets.

lines.serbian: – Nemam.
lines.english: "No."

lines.serbian: – Kako nemaš?!
lines.english: "What do you mean, no?!"

lines.serbian: – Stanite, molim vas! Moramo nazad!
lines.english: "Stop, please! We have to go back!"

lines.serbian: Vozač okreće taksi i vozi nazad.
lines.croatian: Vozač okreće taksi i vozi natrag.
lines.english: The driver turns the taxi around and drives back.

lines.serbian: Svi gledaju tatu.
lines.english: Everyone looks at Dad.

lines.serbian: Mala Ana otvara oči i vadi nešto iz svog ranca.
lines.croatian: Mala Ana otvara oči i vadi nešto iz svog ruksaka.
lines.english: Little Ana opens her eyes and takes something out of her backpack.

lines.serbian: – Da li tražite ovo?
lines.english: "Are you looking for these?"

lines.serbian: U ruci ima četiri pasoša.
lines.english: She has four passports in her hand.

lines.serbian: – Htela sam da ih čuvam – kaže.
lines.english: "I wanted to look after them," she says.

lines.serbian: Vozač se smeje i ponovo okreće taksi.
lines.croatian: Vozač se smije i ponovno okreće taksi.
lines.english: The driver laughs and turns the taxi around again.

lines.serbian: – Na aerodrom!
lines.english: "To the airport!"
